why: Image 2 reads as a specific, lived-in room: a long bar, banquette, record wall and globe table lamps giving pools of warm practical light, with a deep, editorial one-point composition, although the sunlit window patches on the wall do not fit a night shoot. Image 1 looks like a staged CG showroom: the floating neon ring sculpture, the evenly glowing saturated red cabinets and the clean, repetitive slat and terrazzo surfaces give it away as a render, not a photograph of a real place.
